integrity: The universal result follows from an explicit Fourier singular-value proof; an executable exact/finite arithmetic checker provides limited reproducibility checks only.
scientific_limitations: Excludes mass-matrix-weighted function-space norms, long-time bounds, nonuniform grids, variable velocities and nonlinear equations; an inaccessible 2007 P2 finite-element study carries unresolved historical priority risk.
scope: Nodal quadratic semi-Lagrangian interpolation of constant-velocity one-dimensional periodic advection on a uniform grid with an even number of nodes; sharp one-step unweighted Euclidean norm.
title: Sharp one-step Euclidean amplification of quadratic semi-Lagrangian interpolation
